data.name: Actual Role Playing
data.detailed_description:
The biggest triple A movie studio has bought the rights to countless movie franchises—and ran out of budget because of it.

With money too tight to hire real stars, there’s a good chance you will pass the audition to play the protagonist in their upcoming crossover movie.

Act, fight, and improvise your way through a chaotic production where your performance determines the movie’s success... and the investors’ happiness.

A 6 player Co-Op Adventure!

Play together with up to 6 players in a co-op adventure.

  • Use your phone, tablet, or any browser-enabled device as your controller.

  • Join via URL or scan the QR code shown in the lobby.

  • Create your own protagonist by selecting a theme, outfit, and colors.

After a short briefing, you’ll act and fight your way toward the main antagonist while trying to achieve a high performance rating.

Develop your character along with the story!

The writers have a script prepared for you. It's your call to play your part or go off-script!

During the recording of your movie, you will have to choose how to handle scenarios:

  • Collectively vote how to handle situations; and enjoy the consequences.

  • Develop your personality; When things happen, your personality can change—for better or worse.

  • Encounter shops; Use zeny to buy new weapons, equipment or usable items.

  • New ability after combat; Choose a new ability and an associated stat point. The abilities available for your role are based on your theme, equipped weapons or acquired affinity.

  • Performance rating; Your final judgment as a movie star. Raise it by following the director's personal tasks that highlight your character. Or steal the show with unforgettable improvisation.

Engage in turn-based combat!

  • Row-based battlefield; Each team has 3 rows, whereas the front line will defend the back rows against melee attacks and frontal projectiles. Positioning matters—use it to your advantage

  • Use items and abilities; Use your action points wisely to protect your party and communicate to efficiently survive encounters.

  • Turn-based mechanics; Each turn you can choose a main (or basic) ability optionally with a defensive ability or item. When ready, all characters will perform their actions based on the character speed. All defensive abilities will be executed first in order to heal allies or protect against incoming attacks.

  • Minimal combat RNG; No hit chances, critical chances or chance based effects.

data.short_description: Actual Role Playing is a turn-based co-op RPG for up to 6 players, each using a phone or device as their controller. Develop your character, make meaningful choices, and decide how you act in both story and combat. Battle your way to the boss, but beware of the choices you make along the way...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300 of beter
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280 / Intel UHD 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
